newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures limit down on private estimate.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures limit down on private estimate.

text.p: NEW YORK, Aug 14 (Reuters) FCOJ futures fell the 5.00-cent daily limit in the back months on a private estimate of the 1997/98 Florida crop, industry analysts said.

While the estimate has not been released publically, it probably came in close to 230.0 million 90-lb boxes whereas the U.S. Department of Agriculture put this year's crop at a record 225.7 million boxes last month.
Traders said volume was heavy amid mixed selling.
At 1033 EDT, September was down 7.75 at 71.50 cents after hitting a new lifetime low of 71.00 cents. The rest of the board was down the 5.00 cent limit.
